description: This file contains the AdministrationController class for SuiteCRM, handling various administrative actions such as saving tab configurations, language settings, global search settings, and sprite rebuilds.

classes.name: AdministrationController
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative actions in SuiteCRM, including tab management, language settings, global search configurations, AJAX UI updates, and sprite rebuilding.

methods.name: action_savetabs
methods.description: Handles saving enabled and disabled tabs and subpanel configurations.

methods.name: action_savelanguages
methods.description: Handles enabling and disabling languages, ensuring current language isn't disabled.

methods.name: action_saveglobalsearchsettings
methods.description: Saves the global search module settings, accessible only by admins.

methods.name: mergeFtsConfig
methods.description: Merges the existing full_text_engine configuration with new parameters.

methods.name: action_UpdateAjaxUI
methods.description: Updates the AJAX UI configuration for modules.

methods.name: action_callRebuildSprites
methods.description: Triggers the rebuilding of sprite images via the SpriteBuilder, accessible only to admins.
